summary: Rendered attempt-2 blockers with TDD. Removed production-reachable AGENT_POOL_TEST_MODE and AGENT_POOL_MOCK_* environment controls; rejected reserved variables at the launcher boundary. Replaced workspace-derived HOME/XDG with a fresh launcher-owned private runtime parent under tmpdir, with ownership/mode/containment validation and prefix-restricted whole-subtree cleanup. Passed the exact router-selected provider-qualified model (moonshot/kimi-k3 or openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol fallback) to Pi via --model argv after removing static agent model overrides. Canonicalized and reverified the actual Pi executable path, version and sha256 digest immediately before every spawn, using a canonical absolute trusted interpreter and fixed non-caller PATH for all Pi subprocesses. Prompt artifacts are created exclusively beneath the verified runtime parent. Preserved existing five-field emission, sanitization, bounded repair, deadline, package separation and read-only model authority.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: The harness is physically separate from packages/worker-harness and never loads craft-pool.
evidence: packages/orchestrator-harness/package.json and architecture tests remain unchanged; no worker-harness or craft-pool imports were added.
All 43 orchestrator-harness tests and 232 root tests pass.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Its decomposer emits only id, intent, change_spec, acceptance_criteria, and depends_on for each node.
evidence: src/domains/work-intake/decomposition-harness.ts validateCandidate() unchanged; exact-shape regression tests pass.
Work-intake tests confirm rejection of unknown top-level and node fields.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Kimi K3 is the bootstrap decomposition model with only approved fail-closed fallback policy.
evidence: packages/orchestrator-harness/scripts/pi-model-invoker.mjs passes invocation.model via --model argv; tests verify moonshot/kimi-k3 and openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol both appear in argv.

packages/orchestrator-harness/scripts/preflight.mjs now requires at least one approved decomposition candidate instead of every allowed model; Sol-only availability passes preflight and routing selects fallback index 0.
Static agentOverrides.model/fallbackModels removed from config/settings.json so router-selected model cannot be overridden.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: The invocation records prompt, model, tool, package, and code-graph revision provenance.
evidence: src/domains/work-intake/decomposition-contracts.ts adds PiExecutableIdentity and includes piExecutable in DecompositionInvocationRecord.
src/domains/work-intake/decomposition-harness.ts sources launcherIdentity() from the supplied piExecutable when present; tests verify recorded path/version/digest match the actual Pi executable.
Provenance selectedModel equals routing.selectedModel and is passed to Pi argv.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Schema-invalid output is rejected or repaired only within an explicit bounded policy; the model cannot validate, persist, approve, or dispatch its own DAG.
evidence: runDecomposition retains strict validation, response/node limits, one repair maximum, and invocation-wide deadline.
No persistence, approval, queue, Gate 1 or dispatch symbols introduced in launcher or adapter changes.

risks: There remains a narrow time-of-check/time-of-use interval between executable re-verification and operating-system spawn. Reverify immediately before every initial or repair spawn and fail if identity changes.
Pi 0.81.1 model-selector semantics are an external runtime contract. The adapter uses --model with the provider-qualified ID; monitor Pi releases for argument changes.
Whole-subtree cleanup is best-effort in-process; uncatchable termination can leave the runtime parent behind.
The runtime-versions.json launcherDigest currently matches the Node.js test fake used in this repository. A production deployment must pin the digest of the actual Pi executable.
Deterministic secret recognition and provider cancellation lag remain residual risks from attempt-1.
recommended_next_step: Hand to local-craft-evaluator on a different, not-lower-capability model for A/F/T review; if evaluator pairing cannot be enforced, fail closed and escalate.

implementation_notes: No commit was made per task instructions; red and green evidence both reference the same working-tree SHA.

Production-reachable AGENT_POOL_TEST_MODE, AGENT_POOL_MOCK_*, and AGENT_POOL_TEST_RECORD_PATH handling removed from launch.mjs, run-decomposition.mjs and pi-model-invoker.mjs; reserved variables are rejected at the launcher boundary.
Test-local fake Pi executables (Node.js scripts) replace environment mocks for orchestrator-harness integration tests; work-intake tests continue direct in-process injection into runDecomposition.

A fresh launcher-owned private runtime parent is created under tmpdir with 0o700 mode; HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, cache and prompt directories are derived beneath it and validated for ownership, type, permissions and containment.
Whole-subtree cleanup is owned by launch.mjs in the child-exit handler and restricted to paths whose basename starts with agent-pool-orch-runtime- and resolve under the runtime base.
Pi executable identity is canonicalized and verified in pi-identity.mjs; preflight and pi-model-invoker.mjs share the same verification, with immediate re-verification before every model spawn.

All Pi subprocesses (version, registry, initial model, repair) are spawned through the canonical absolute trusted interpreter (process.execPath) with a fixed PATH of /usr/bin:/bin, independent of caller PATH.
The router-selected provider-qualified model is passed via --model argv; static per-agent model/fallback defaults were removed from settings.json.
Provenance now carries piExecutable.path, version and digest identifying the actual verified Pi executable, described as verified-before-spawn.
